invariants.description: Log entry serialization and deserialization is perfectly lossless and canonical.
State transition outcome matches formal TLA+ state machine oracle across 10,000 steps.
Replaying duplicate committed RPC log entries produces zero state mutations.

fault_injection_matrix.mitigation_or_invariant: Heartbeat quorum ensures leader election completes within 3 simulated ticks.
Logical Lamport clocks prevent split-brain under severe monotonic skew.
Strict sequence numbers reject stale RPC frames and duplicate votes.
Majority quorum barrier prevents minority partitions from committing entries.

transitions.guard_or_effect: Increment term, vote for self, broadcast RequestVote RPC.
Initialize nextIndex/matchIndex, broadcast initial AppendEntries heartbeat.
Update currentTerm, step down to Follower immediately.
Update currentTerm, clear votes, step down to Follower.

structure_aware_fuzzing.corpus_strategy: Grammar-based RPC seed corpus mutated across malformed headers, negative terms, and payload sizes.

mutation_falsification.mutated_invariant: Invert term comparison from strictly greater to greater-or-equal in RequestVote handler.
mutation_falsification.observed_failure_seed_or_counterexample: Seed 0xCAFE_BABE failed at tick 412: candidate granted vote to lower term.

verdict.rationale: All invariants, seeded DST simulation with virtual clock, state machine model, and structure-aware fuzzing are verified.

Modification of election timeout intervals or clock drift models
